description: This PHP source file defines the ReportGeneratorDao class, which handles database operations related to report generation, including fetching, saving, deleting report data, and related entities such as display fields, filters, and report groups within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

classes.name: ReportGeneratorDao
classes.description: Data Access Object responsible for managing report-related database operations within the HRM system, including CRUD operations for reports, display fields, filter fields, and report groups.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Fetches display fields selected for a specific report ID.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldGroupIdsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of display field groups associated with a report.

methods.name: getSelectedCompositeDisplayFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Gets composite display fields linked to a report.

methods.name: getSelectedFilterFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Fetches filter fields selected for a specific report.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves a report entity by its ID.

methods.name: getSummaryDisplayFieldByReportId
methods.description: Gets summary display fields related to a report.

methods.name: saveReport
methods.description: Persists a report along with its associated display groups, fields, and filters, handling transaction management.

methods.name: saveSelectedFilterField
methods.description: Saves a list of selected filter fields.

methods.name: saveSelectedDisplayField
methods.description: Saves selected display fields for a report.

methods.name: saveSelectedDisplayFieldGroup
methods.description: Saves selected display field groups for a report.

methods.name: getFilterFieldByName
methods.description: Fetches a filter field entity by its name.

methods.name: searchPimDefinedReports
methods.description: Searches for PIM-defined reports based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchPimDefinedReportsPaginator
methods.description: Builds and returns a paginator for PIM-defined report search results.

methods.name: getSearchPimDefinedReportCount
methods.description: Returns the count of PIM-defined reports matching search criteria.

methods.name: deletePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Deletes reports by IDs within the PIM report group.

methods.name: getReportById
methods.description: Retrieves a report entity by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingReportIdsForPim
methods.description: Fetches existing report IDs for a set within the PIM report group.

methods.name: getReportGroupByName
methods.description: Fetches a report group by its name.

methods.name: deleteExistingReportRecordsByReportId
methods.description: Deletes linked display fields and filters for a report before cleanup or update.

methods.name: deleteSelectedDisplayFieldGroups
methods.description: Deletes all selected display field groups associated with a report.

methods.name: deleteSelectedDisplayFields
methods.description: Deletes all selected display fields for a report.

methods.name: deleteSelectedFilterFields
methods.description: Deletes all selected filter fields for a report.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldIdsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of display fields selected for a report.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldIdsByReportGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves display field IDs for a report filtered by display field group.

methods.name: getIncludeType
methods.description: Fetches the include filter field linked to a report.

methods.name: isIncludeHeader
methods.description: Checks if a display field group is marked as a header for a report.

methods.name: getDisplayFieldGroupIdList
methods.description: Gets list of display field group IDs associated with a report.

methods.name: getSkippedSelectedFilterFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Gets filter fields that are skipped based on certain conditions.

methods.name: getAllDisplayFieldGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all display field groups.

methods.name: getAllDisplayFields
methods.description: Retrieves all display fields that belong to display field groups.

methods.name: getAllFilterFields
methods.description: Retrieves all filter fields related to the 'pim' report group, excluding the 'include' filter.
